title: Agentic-Priors: Using Large Language Models to Address the Cold Start Problem in Preference Elicitation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An agent that learns a user's preferences from their choices faces a cold start problem: before any choices are observed, it must rely solely on a prior. Informative priors are usually fitted to historical choice data, which new tasks and deployments lack. To address this, we present Agentic-Priors, which lets agentic systems use the implicit knowledge of large language models (LLMs) instead. Specifically, an LLM states a new user's trade-offs in interpretable terms, such as willingness to pay or value of time, which we map to a prior over multinomial logit coefficients. This prior is then refined by a Bayesian learner as choices are observed. Across seven choice datasets, Agentic-Priors improves cold start accuracy over an uninformed prior by 5-40 percentage points. translated_title: 智能体先验：利用大语言模型解决偏好引出中的冷启动问题
translated_abstract: 一个从用户选择中学习用户偏好的智能体面临冷启动问题：在观察到任何选择之前，它只能依赖先验分布。有信息的先验通常是从历史选择数据中拟合得到的，而新任务和新部署场景往往缺乏这类数据。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Agentic-Priors，让智能体系统转而利用大语言模型（LLM）的隐式知识。具体而言，LLM以可解释的方式（如支付意愿或时间价值）表达新用户的权衡取舍，我们将这些表述映射为多项logit系数上的先验分布。随着用户选择的不断观察，该先验随后由贝叶斯学习器进行精化更新。在七个选择数据集上，Agentic-Priors相比无信息先验将冷启动预测准确率提升了5-40个百分点。它还在三个数据集上超越了AutoElicit（一种最先进的LLM先验引出方法），仅在一个数据集上表现稍逊。此外，其准确率比上下文学习方法最高高出18个百分点。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Agentic-Priors方法，利用大语言模型以支付意愿、时间价值等可解释形式表达新用户的偏好权衡，将其映射为多项logit系数先验并通过贝叶斯学习随观测选择更新，在缺乏历史数据的冷启动场景下将偏好预测准确率提升5-40个百分点，并超越现有最先进的AutoElicit方法。
en_tdlr: Agentic-Priors leverages LLMs to articulate new users' trade-offs in interpretable terms (e.g., willingness to pay, value of time), maps them to a prior over multinomial logit coefficients, and refines this prior through Bayesian learning as choices are observed, improving cold-start preference prediction accuracy by 5-40 percentage points and outperforming the state-of-the-art AutoElicit method.
